name: limit-schema-set-members-at-limit
description: A slot's set binding with exactly 1,024 distinct members, the schema's published maximum set-members count, canonicalises normally and sorts by NFC code point order.
notes: The schema's maximum set-members count is 1,024. Refs use the reserved test/ fixture namespace and are script-generated; the input array is given in reverse-sorted order so the vector also exercises the set-member sort at this scale. See limit-schema-set-members-over-limit for the one-past-limit refusal.
